name: karaokenatin
description: LAN karaoke system: Tauri host app with an embedded web server and browser-based guest remotes

scripts.dev:host: pnpm run build:shared && cd apps/host && pnpm run tauri:dev
scripts.build:host: pnpm run build:shared && cd apps/host && pnpm run build && pnpm run tauri build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:shared && cd packages/shared && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && cd ../../apps/host && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:rust
